rationale: The authoritative standard requires interest_rate to be the all-in stated coupon including PIK. The source SOI has separate Cash Interest Rate and PIK columns for flagged positions. The bundle/extract kept the cash leg as interest_rate (for example Alto stored 5.0 while the source row shows 5.00% cash and 11.99% PIK; Delta stored 3.0 while source shows 3.00% cash and 7.00% PIK; Establishment Labs stored 3.0 while source shows 3.00% cash and 6.00% PIK). Therefore the stored interest_rate is not all-in and is below cash plus PIK.
